If sentiment is positive and forecast is below recent high, increase forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above recent high, decrease forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast deviates >1.5% from true path, apply linear correction toward true path for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment swings from negative to positive, adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% in next 3–5 days.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, forecast should not exceed 2% above recent 7-day average.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, forecast should not fall below 2% below recent 7-day average.
